rows.name: WeightedMSELoss
rows.notes: Strong clean-data baseline; pair with calibration/OOD metrics for deployment checks.

rows.name: WeightedHuberLoss
rows.notes: Robust default for moderate outliers before heavier methods.

rows.name: PseudoHuberLoss
rows.notes: Smooth, everywhere-differentiable approximation to Huber. Safer default than Huber when second-order optimisers or automatic curvature estimation are in use.

rows.name: LogCoshLoss
rows.notes: Smooth log-cosh penalty; behaves like L2 near zero and L1 in the tails.  Numerically stable variant using log1p for large residuals.

rows.name: CharbonnierLoss
rows.notes: Smooth L1 surrogate sqrt(r² + ε²).  Differentiable at zero unlike plain L1; tune ε for the expected noise floor.

rows.name: TukeyBiweightLoss
rows.notes: Redescending M-estimator that caps and eventually ignores extreme residuals.  Non-convex; start from a Huber/PseudoHuber warm-up before switching.

rows.name: CauchyLoss
rows.notes: Negative log-likelihood of the Cauchy distribution.  Very robust to extreme outliers; heavier-tailed than Huber/PseudoHuber.  Non-convex — prefer a convex warm-up.

rows.name: BarronLoss
rows.notes: Continuous family parameterised by shape α that interpolates between L2 (α=2), Cauchy-like (α=0), and more robust penalties (α<0).  Useful for ablations and hyper-parameter sweeps.

rows.name: AdaptiveRobustLoss
rows.notes: Learnable Barron loss: α and scale are optimised jointly with the model.  Add ``loss_fn.parameters()`` to the optimizer.  Strongest when the noise regime is unknown a priori.

rows.name: CVaRLoss
rows.notes: Conditional Value-at-Risk: averages the worst α fraction of per-sample losses.  Pairs with any base loss (MSE, Huber, Cauchy, Tukey).  For multi-output targets, CVaR selects the worst samples, not the worst per-element errors.

rows.name: DensityWeightedLoss
rows.notes: Research/Advanced method. Validate calibration after reweighting; astronomical benchmarks currently show this is highly data- and protocol-sensitive. Not recommended as a default.

rows.name: PropensityWeightedLoss
rows.notes: IPW-style loss for covariate-dependent label observation bias.

rows.name: LDSLoss
rows.notes: Research/Advanced method. Aggressive reweighting can distort calibration; check intervals post-hoc.

rows.name: FocalRLoss
rows.notes: Focal regression loss focusing on hard (rare) examples via adaptive weighting.

rows.name: FeatureDistributionSmoother
rows.notes: Feature Distribution Smoothing (FDS) layer. Smooths feature mean and variance across target bins to transfer representation power to tail regions.

rows.name: GaussianCRPSLoss
rows.notes: Analytic Continuous Ranked Probability Score for diagonal Gaussian predictions. Proper scoring rule with target-native units; less tail-sensitive than NLL.

rows.name: MultiQuantileLoss
rows.notes: Multi-quantile loss; multiple quantile predictions per target dimension.

rows.name: ExpectileLoss
rows.notes: Asymmetric least-squares expectile estimation; L2 analog of quantile regression.

rows.name: MultiExpectileLoss
rows.notes: Simultaneous multi-expectile loss for distribution-free interval estimation.

rows.name: AsymmetricLeastSquaresLoss
rows.notes: Base asymmetric least-squares loss for expectile regression.

rows.name: ConformalLoss
rows.notes: Coverage guarantees, not epistemic/aleatoric decomposition.

rows.name: UACQR
rows.notes: CQR with nonconformity scores divided by predicted quantile band width.

rows.name: DensityConformal
rows.notes: Density-adaptive conformal intervals for long-tail target regions.

rows.name: PrevalenceAdjustedCP
rows.notes: Group-prevalence adjusted conformal intervals for rare-target coverage.

rows.name: MonteCarloConformal
rows.notes: Conformal on MC predictive samples with uncertainty-normalized residual scores.

rows.name: SLSConformal
rows.notes: Conformal prediction regions using Super-Level-Set regression frontiers.

rows.name: SplitConformal
rows.notes: Standard split conformal prediction with finite-sample coverage guarantees.

rows.name: CQR
rows.notes: Conformalized Quantile Regression: adapts interval width to heteroscedasticity.

rows.name: CTI
rows.notes: Conditional Tightness Indicator for distributional conformal prediction.

rows.name: CVPlus
rows.notes: CV+ conformal prediction utilizing out-of-fold residuals for cross-validation ensembles.

rows.name: JackknifePlus
rows.notes: Jackknife+ conformal prediction, equivalent to CV+ with leave-one-out cross-validation.

rows.name: EnsembleBatchCP
rows.notes: Ensemble Batch CP (EnbPI) using out-of-bag ensemble residuals to compute conformal intervals.

rows.name: NoisyTargetGaussianNLL
rows.notes: Adds target-noise variance to predictive variance before NLL scoring; strongest when probabilistic label uncertainty is genuinely available.

rows.name: ConsistencyRegLoss
rows.notes: Teacher/student consistency regularization with regression base loss.

rows.name: PseudoLabelNLL
rows.notes: Blends observed labels and pseudo-labels with confidence weighting.

rows.name: PseudoLabelConsistencyLoss
rows.notes: Composite point-regression loss for pseudo-label and teacher-consistency training.

rows.name: TransformedTargetLoss
rows.notes: Base class for target-transformed losses; any forward/inverse transform pair.

rows.name: LogTransformLoss
rows.notes: Positive-support log-space loss for multiplicative noise and strong right skew.

rows.name: BoxCoxTransformLoss
rows.notes: Tunable positive-support power transform for skewed targets.

rows.name: SqrtTransformLoss
rows.notes: Square-root-space loss for count-like or moderate variance-growth targets.

rows.name: YeoJohnsonTransformLoss
rows.notes: Signed-target power transform when Box-Cox/log are invalid.

rows.name: PredictionPoweredInference
rows.notes: Frequentist population/parameter inference layer that combines small labeled sets with larger prediction-only sets.

rows.name: dr_ate
rows.notes: Cross-fitted doubly-robust ATE with overlap diagnostics and robust CI.

rows.name: dr_cate
rows.notes: Cross-fitted DR pseudo-outcome regression for heterogeneous treatment effects.

rows.name: OrdinalCrossEntropyLoss
rows.notes: Class-logit baseline for ordered targets; also accepts soft bin targets for ambiguous labels and soft pseudo labels.

rows.name: CumulativeLinkLoss
rows.notes: Cumulative-threshold objective with K-1 logits for ordinal labels or soft ordered-bin PMFs.

rows.name: CORALLoss
rows.notes: CORAL-style cumulative ordinal objective.

rows.name: CensoredGaussianNLLLoss
rows.notes: Gaussian censored likelihood for left/right/interval-censored targets.

rows.name: CensoredQuantileLoss
rows.notes: Quantile-style objective for censored and bounded target intervals.

rows.name: AFTLoss
rows.notes: Log-normal accelerated failure-time objective with censoring support.

rows.name: PoissonDevianceLoss
rows.notes: Poisson deviance (negative log-likelihood) for count targets with variance = mean.

rows.name: PoissonLikelihoodRatioLoss
rows.notes: Poisson likelihood-ratio loss for model comparison and ablation studies.

rows.name: NegativeBinomialNLLLoss
rows.notes: Negative Binomial NLL for overdispersed count data with variance = mu + mu^2/r.

rows.name: ZeroInflatedPoissonNLLLoss
rows.notes: Zero-inflated Poisson NLL for count data with excess zeros.

rows.name: TweedieLoss
rows.notes: Tweedie loss; variance ∝ mean^p (1<p<2 for compound Poisson-gamma).

rows.name: GammaLoss
rows.notes: Gamma NLL for positive, right-skewed continuous targets (Tweedie p=2).

rows.name: InverseGaussianLoss
rows.notes: Inverse Gaussian NLL for positive targets; variance ∝ mean^3 (Tweedie p=3).

rows.name: CompoundPoissonLoss
rows.notes: Compound Poisson-gamma loss for mixed zero-inflated continuous positive targets.

rows.name: EvidentialRegressionLoss
rows.notes: NIG evidential regression; single-pass aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty.

rows.name: PoissonGaussianMixtureLoss
rows.notes: Poisson-Gaussian mixture for count data with Gaussian readout noise.

rows.name: EnhancedPoissonGaussianMixtureLoss
rows.notes: Enhanced Poisson-Gaussian mixture with improved stability and learnable parameters.

rows.name: PoissonGaussianLikelihoodRatioLoss
rows.notes: Poisson-Gaussian likelihood-ratio loss for model comparison and hypothesis testing.

rows.name: BoundedHead
rows.notes: Enforces bounded output support via sigmoid scaling.

rows.name: NonCrossingSort
rows.notes: Post-head sorting transform to remove crossing violations.

rows.name: VarianceTemperatureScaler
rows.notes: Scalar variance temperature fitted by NLL minimization.

rows.name: ConformalRegressor
rows.notes: Experimental sklearn-style wrapper (may change in 0.4): split, normalized, CQR, CV+ and Jackknife+ intervals on any base (scikit-learn, LightGBM, torch module, TabularFit) through SplitConformal / CQR / CVPlus; parity with MAPIE on shared bases is tested.

rows.name: CalibratedRegressor
rows.notes: Experimental wrapper (may change in 0.4): variance temperature (optionally with an isotonic mean map) fitted on a held-out split for any Gaussian-output base; optional conformal intervals.

rows.name: calibrated_deep_ensemble
rows.notes: Experimental one-call recipe (may change in 0.4): Gaussian TabularMLP ensemble with mixture moments, variance temperature on a held-out carve and optional conformal intervals. Evidence so far is synthetic.

rows.name: IsotonicMeanCalibrator
rows.notes: Monotonic regression map for mean prediction calibration.

rows.name: PITCalibrator
rows.notes: Empirical CDF remapping for PIT distribution calibration.

rows.name: MDNLoss
rows.notes: Single-model mixture predictive spread is not epistemic/aleatoric decomposition; use MDNEnsembleModel for model-disagreement signals.

rows.name: NoiseAwareDensityLoss
rows.notes: Known Gaussian label-error convolution: exact diagonal MDN, scalar-flow quadrature, otherwise Monte Carlo. Joint densities require complete target vectors or whole-row masks; no latent-truth calibration guarantee.

rows.name: BinnedDensityLoss
rows.notes: Finite-bin scalar distribution with uniform within-bin sampling/CDF. Gaussian-smoothed target cross-entropy is not a measurement marginal likelihood or deconvolution estimator.

rows.name: UncertaintyAwareConR
rows.notes: Scalar Gaussian-error interval probabilities soften ConR memberships; zero errors recover the hard objective. No multivariate radial-noise approximation or calibrated predictive uncertainty.

rows.name: NormalizingFlowMap
rows.notes: Time-conditioned invertible affine-coupling flow map with exact endpoint likelihood and few-step transport. Tabular instantiation, not the full image-scale autoregressive NFM; no built-in label-noise measurement model.

rows.name: ConformalizedDensity
rows.notes: Split-conformal level sets for any -log p(y|x) score; scalar intervals via CTI grid inversion, multi-target level-set membership. Valid marginal coverage, not conditional coverage.

rows.name: ContrastiveFlowConformal
rows.notes: Conformal level sets around a ContrastiveFlowLoss positive density; coverage is split-conformal, not a likelihood-ratio calibration.

rows.name: WaldoConformal
rows.notes: WALD-statistic Neyman-inversion regions from conditional mean/covariance; binned critical values approximate WALDO's quantile regression. Valid marginal coverage; conditional coverage depends on critical-value fit.

rows.name: WaldoPosteriorCalibrator
rows.notes: WALD regions using conditional moments estimated from predictive samples (flows/ensembles); supports joint multi-target regions.

rows.name: FlowMatchingMLP
rows.notes: OT-CFM velocity field with a short Euler sampler. No exact likelihood; use sample-based CRPS/energy/coverage/PIT, or an ODE likelihood if NLL is required.

rows.name: PZRecipeLoss
rows.notes: CE + equal-width binned-CDF + RnC-N first-stage photo-z objective. Binned conditional CDF, not a continuous density likelihood; bin centers and normalization must be fitted from training data.

rows.name: TriLoss
rows.notes: Methods-paper CE + exact binned-CRPS + RnC-N tri-loss. Uses the same quantile bins as PZRecipeLoss; CRPS differs from the squared binned CDF.

rows.name: NormalizingFlowLoss
rows.notes: Optional dependency (`zuko`); often compared after MDN baselines.

rows.name: SLSLoss
rows.notes: Super-Level-Set Regression. Estimates minimum-volume prediction regions using strictly volume-preserving flows. Zero external dependencies.

rows.name: ContrastiveFlowLoss
rows.notes: InfoNCE-style contrastive likelihood-ratio ranking over flow log-densities; temperature=1 and margin=0 is the likelihood-ratio regime, otherwise the scores are tempered rankings. Distinct from the Elsharkawy-Kahn contrastive normalizing-flow density-shaping method. For classifier-based NRE see NeuralRatioLoss.

rows.name: NeuralRatioLoss
rows.notes: Classifier-based neural ratio estimation (binary BCE or multiclass). Trains a classifier to distinguish true (x, theta) pairs from mismatched ones; the logit estimates log p(x|theta)-log p(x), so argmax over candidate hypotheses is the MLE and the training label/simulation prior cancels. Needs a reference prior for the negative contexts; validate with SBC/TARP before trusting posterior weights.

rows.name: LatentNN
rows.notes: Jointly optimises network parameters and per-sample latent clean inputs under a Gaussian quadratic penalty. Requires known input noise sigma_x.

rows.name: RegressionCalibration
rows.notes: Classical Regression Calibration. Replaces noisy features with their conditional expectation given the observed features and noise model. Provides analytical posterior samplers for Gaussian priors.

rows.name: SIMEX
rows.notes: Simulation-Extrapolation (SIMEX) algorithm for parameter/estimand-level bias correction. Adds simulated noise to features and extrapolates back to the zero-noise limit.

rows.name: ErrorAwareFeatureEncoder
rows.notes: Encodes raw features alongside derived quality signals (log-uncertainty, SNR, quality-gated features). Lightweight alternative to latent-input optimization.

rows.name: NoiseAwareRegressor
rows.notes: Convenience wrapper pairing an ErrorAwareFeatureEncoder with a configurable prediction backbone for noisy-input regression.

rows.name: FunctionalEIVLoss
rows.notes: Research/Advanced method. Powerful but ergonomically awkward; explicit adapters or simpler MC input-noise baselines can be easier to debug in practice.

rows.name: InputNoiseAugmentationLoss
rows.notes: Monte-Carlo input-noise augmentation. Perturbs observed inputs to average the downstream loss, providing data augmentation and regularization.

rows.name: LatentMarginalizationLoss
rows.notes: Proper latent-variable Errors-in-Variables Loss. Computes marginal likelihood via Monte Carlo integration over the input error posterior.

rows.name: NoisyInputPredictor
rows.notes: High-level wrapper for performing inference on noisy inputs via marginalization.

rows.name: InputNoiseMDNLoss
rows.notes: Marginalization for MDN heads; robust to input noise in multimodal scenarios.

rows.name: InputNoiseBinnedPDFLoss
rows.notes: Marginalization for binned-PDF/ordinal heads.

rows.name: HeteroscedasticBatchEnsembleModel
rows.notes: Shared-weight ensemble variant for lower-latency uncertainty decomposition.

rows.name: PZRecipe
rows.notes: Lean two-stage FT-Transformer + bin-classifier photo-z model. Stage 1 uses PZRecipeLoss; stage 2 freezes features. Reference structure, not the historical TabM training schedule.

rows.name: TabularMLP
rows.notes: Strong-default tabular backbone (periodic embeddings, robust-scaled inputs, AdamW + one-cycle, early stopping via fit_tabular); head width is set to match any torchregress loss. Evidence so far is synthetic and diabetes benchmarks, not real medium-size tabular suites.

rows.name: BatchEnsembleRegressor
rows.notes: Facade over batch-ensemble heads with optional alpha scaling and BatchEnsembleOutput for mean/std_epistemic-style access.

rows.name: BinnedPDFEnsembleModel
rows.notes: Averages bin-wise probabilities in predictive-distribution space; strongest when discrete PDFs are the desired output surface.

rows.name: CumulativeLinkEnsembleModel
rows.notes: Averages ordinal CDF / PMF predictions across members rather than averaging thresholds.

rows.name: MDNEnsembleModel
rows.notes: Uses a mixture-of-mixtures aggregation to avoid MDN component label-switching across members.

rows.name: BayesianLinearHead
rows.notes: Exact conjugate Gaussian linear regression on fixed features; pairs with frozen representations. See examples/benchmarks/bayesian_linear_head_lowshot_adaptation.py and bayesian_linear_head_online_drift.py for synthetic adaptation baselines.

rows.name: RecursiveBayesianHead
rows.notes: Streaming conjugate updates with optional precision forgetting; not a substitute for ensembles/SWAG/BNN when nonlinear epistemic UQ is required.

rows.name: BetaNLLLoss
rows.notes: Variance-detached weighting on Gaussian NLL for heteroscedastic heads.

rows.name: FaithfulGaussianLoss
rows.notes: MSE on mean plus NLL on variance with detached mean in the residual.

rows.name: BalancedMSELoss
rows.notes: Inverse bin-frequency weighted MSE; call fit(train_targets) on fixed bin edges.

rows.name: BalancedMSEBMC
rows.notes: True noise-adaptive Balanced MSE (BMC; Ren et al. 2022). Batch-coupled softmax over targets with a label prior and target-noise scale; call fit(train_targets), single-output targets, batches >= ~64 recommended.

rows.name: RankSimLoss
rows.notes: RankSim ranking-similarity regularizer (Gong et al. 2022): matches label-distance and feature-similarity rankings; add gamma * loss to a task loss. O(B^2); distinct from Rank-N-Contrast.

rows.name: BinReweightedMSELoss
rows.notes: Inverse bin counts with Laplace-style noise_sigma smoothing; optional quantile bins.

rows.name: GaussianWassersteinBoundLoss
rows.notes: Frobenius surrogate on matrix roots for mean+covariance supervision; pair with pseudo-labels or oracle covariance targets.

rows.name: NeighborhoodCovariancePseudoLabeler
rows.notes: Heuristic local target-covariance estimates from input-space neighbours; experimental. See examples/wasserstein_bound_hybrid_pretrain_demo.py.

rows.name: OptimalTransportCoverageGap
rows.notes: Score ECDF gap diagnostics between calibration and target pools.

rows.name: ScoreCDFReweighter
rows.notes: Simplex weights on calibration scores via CDF matching (OT-inspired surrogate).

rows.name: WeightedSplitConformalAdapter
rows.notes: Weighted split conformal threshold for classification-style nonconformity scores.

rows.name: weighted_split_classification_predictive_batch
rows.notes: Builds PredictiveBatch from a calibrated WeightedSplitConformalAdapter.

rows.name: DelayedLabelResidualAdapter
rows.notes: COSA-style output-space residual adaptation under delayed label observations.

rows.name: WeightedConformalRegressionAdapter
rows.notes: Weighted split-conformal regression using classifier density-ratio estimation.

rows.name: TaylorInducedCovarianceHead
rows.notes: Taylor-Induced Covariance head tying predicted covariance to Jacobian and Hessian of the mean model.

rows.name: NaturalHeteroscedasticHead
rows.notes: Gaussian natural parameterization head mapping output to mean and log-variance.

rows.name: NaturalReparamHead
rows.notes: Reparameterization helper mapping natural parameters to mean and log-variance.

rows.name: HeteroscedasticLaplaceRegressor
rows.notes: Last-layer Laplace posterior approximation over heteroscedastic heads.

rows.name: VIDSRegressor
rows.notes: Variational inference regressor under distribution shift using covariate-conditional adaptive priors.

rows.name: IVON
rows.notes: Improved Variational Online Newton optimizer derived from the Bayesian Learning Rule framework.

rows.name: TaskAgnosticCorrelations
rows.notes: Task-Agnostic Correlations metric to evaluate covariance prediction quality.

rows.name: SemiConformalCalibrator
rows.notes: Semi-supervised conformal prediction intervals under covariate/label shift.

rows.name: BinnedLabelShiftEstimator
rows.notes: Estimates and corrects target prior distributions under label shift using BBSE or EM.

rows.name: TeacherStudentTrainer
rows.notes: Orchestrates teacher-student training with heteroscedastic weight gating and instability scoring.

rows.name: ForwardInversionRegressor
rows.notes: Generative y->x surrogate (inverse-regression / auto-decoder construction) trained with the known observable errors (full heteroscedastic Gaussian NLL, robust Student-t, or weighted least squares), then inverted per object by maximum likelihood. Removes input attenuation and inverse-regression prior bias; assumes accurate labels, an identifiable decoder and an observation model that covers every pixel channel.

rows.name: SplitMeasurementLoss
rows.notes: Cross-product loss over two independent noisy measurements; cancels input attenuation without a noise model. Requires paired exposures and a model linear in the features for exact unbiasedness.

rows.name: CorrectedScoreEIVLoss
rows.notes: Stefanski-Nakamura corrected score: subtracts the measurement-error curvature from the squared residual instead of adding a TLS gradient penalty. Needs the input-noise covariance and a vmap-safe model; can produce negative per-sample losses.

rows.name: PrimeLoss
rows.notes: PRIME proxy alignment: learnable feature proxies with uniformly spaced targets; every mini-batch receives tail gradient even when no tail samples are present. Scalar targets only; proxies must be added to the optimizer.

rows.name: ConR
rows.notes: Contrastive regularizer for imbalanced regression: pushes apart label-distant pairs whose predictions collapsed, weighted by inverse label density. Needs the model prediction; O(B^2) per batch.

rows.name: VIRLoss
rows.notes: Variational Imbalanced Regression loss: Normal-Inverse-Gamma evidential head with label-density reweighting and evidential regularisation. Call fit(train_targets) to estimate the smoothed label density; outputs a Student-t predictive.

rows.name: VIRRegressor
rows.notes: End-to-end variational imbalanced regressor: feature encoder + probabilistic latent smoothing + NIG predictive head; predict(return_std=True) returns mean and evidential predictive uncertainty. Single-output scalar targets.

rows.name: ContinuousGroupDRO
rows.notes: Group DRO over target bins: exponentiated-gradient weights on the worst-performing target regime. Equalizes per-regime mean loss (unlike CVaR, which chases individual outliers); needs physical target bins.

rows.name: GroupDROTrainer
rows.notes: Convenience trainer wrapping a model with ContinuousGroupDRO; exposes final group weights and per-regime losses for diagnosis.

rows.name: VarianceRestoringCalibrator
rows.notes: Marginal de-shrinkage of conditional-mean predictions via moment matching or 1-D optimal transport. Restores population variance/tails but is not conditional calibration: for an already calibrated MSE predictor it can increase MSE.
